svg.text: L_NN (VAPMIP) — the hat as coded, tilted by the coupling, against the Standard-Model hat
L_bias is exactly −V_SM, so the hat is the same quartic. The coupling −(g/φ)ψ·β tilts it (g = 0.2): the hilltop moves. As coded with μ² = −1 the potential is a bowl (no brim).
the brim of the untilted hat (r = 1)
the hilltop of the TILTED hat (moved off centre by the coupling)
violet wire: L_bias as coded with μ² = −1 (a bowl, clipped at z = 2.4)
paths from the brim toward the hilltop (leapfrog, E = V at the hilltop)
